title: Protector of Fire / Pure Flame Elemental
summary: Clear the elemental ring to summon its final fire guardian.
overview: Clear the elemental ring to summon its final fire guardian.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Finish each wave and prepare for the two possible finale variants.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Eight initial kill signals summon four furious magma guardians.
Defeat those four to summon two inflamed champions.
After both champions die, the final spawn is Protector of Fire or the epic-specific Pure Flame Elemental, depending on the qualifying wizard signal.

notes: Approval E301. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
